hints.title: Global Busy Interval Merging
hints.text: Collect all working intervals across all employees into a single list and sort them by start time to detect unworked gaps.

hints.title: Interval Merging and Gap Identification
hints.text: Maintain the maximum end time seen so far. If the next interval starts strictly after this maximum end, the gap between maximum end and next start represents free time.

hints.title: Free Time Blueprint
hints.text: Flatten all intervals into list, sort by start. Initialize prev_end = intervals[0].end. For curr in intervals[1:]: if curr.start > prev_end: append Interval(prev_end, curr.start). Update prev_end = max(prev_end, curr.end).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of intervals across all employees
complexity.notes: Sorting all N intervals dominates runtime; single pass merge completes in O(N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Timeline simulation per unit minute cannot scale to 10^8 time boundaries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear array of intervals allows sorting and gap extraction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorting busy intervals by start and finding gaps where curr.start > prev_end.
